# htop Attribution

The `htop` command in tOS is an original implementation written from scratch for tOS, styled after and named after [htop](https://github.com/htop-dev/htop).

The upstream htop project is licensed under GPL-2.0-only. No source code from htop is compiled into or linked with tOS; instead, this directory maintains htop's GPL-2.0 license text to properly credit the project that inspired tOS's process monitor command.
